name: Women's Class B blue short-sleeve blouse and skirt (nametag position only) plain epaulet straps (overlay, registered to garment-blues-class-b-blouse-female; no grade)
size_basis: The garment epaulet strap landmark polygons (epaulet_right / epaulet_left of garment-blues-class-b-blouse-female, width 1.75 in): the strap itself in the shirt colour with the shirt's line tones, topstitching and a button. The regulation gives no strap dimension.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in)
documented: the shirt and blouse have epaulets for every member (CAPR 39-1 4.1.11.1.1 / 4.1.12.2)
shoulder cords are worn along the shoulder seam and, if the garment has an epaulet, underneath it (9.3, 9.4.1)
no grade goes on the strap itself: officers slip a gray or blue epaulet sleeve over it, NCOs and airmen wear chevrons or collar insignia
assumed: strap size and shape (the traced base image does not draw it)
